item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The AIFA airport was reported to have lost approximately 4.02 million pesos per operating day through December 2022 after subsidies were deducted, with operating expenses 9.2 times daily revenue; it handled 1.3 million passengers against a first-year target of 2.4 million, while its director projected financial profitability if traffic reached 200 daily flights.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the attribution that the airport was inaugurated under López Obrador."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0042-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
